gerd_zinc_carnosine.name: Zinc-Carnosine
gerd_zinc_carnosine.key: 17 mg zinc + 58 mg L‑carnosine (75 mg zinc carnosine, as PepZin GI)
gerd_zinc_carnosine.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Zinc-Carnosine SS ND414' Rev. 1/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 capsule, 60 servings; zinc (as zinc-carnosine, PepZin GI) 17 mg, L-carnosine 58 mg; '75 mg zinc-carnosine per serving'; directions 'Take one capsule twice daily between meals'. Same amounts as products DB R154 (Metagenics chart). Sheet dose is 1 a day with GI Integrity, whose scoop supplies the second zinc-carnosine dose (keeps the plan's zinc near 38 mg), and the label's 1 twice a day without it. No current product-page URL turned up in the emails searched (they give links for GI Integrity, Spore Probio and Magnesium Glycinate only), so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: shared R154 file, a 4x stopgap enlarged from the 88x160 chart thumbnail (SOFT): needs Asher's print master (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/ or the 10/1/26 catalog PDF).

gerd_dgl_pro.name: Licorice DGL Pro
gerd_dgl_pro.key: Per 3 tablets: 75 mg DGL extract, 100 mg glycine, 100 mg L‑glutamine, 30 mg NAC, 5 mg zinc
gerd_dgl_pro.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Licorice DGL Pro SS ND1337' Rev. 8/26, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 3 chewable tablets, 30 servings; zinc (as zinc glycinate) 5 mg, glycine 100 mg, L-glutamine 100 mg, deglycyrrhizinated licorice extract 75 mg, N-acetyl-cysteine 30 mg; directions 'Chew 3 tablets after each meal'. Same amounts as products DB R2193 (Integrative Therapeutics and Microbiome Labs charts); size R2193 90T on the 10/1/26 price list. Sheet uses 3 a day, after dinner (Asher's GERD protocol email, 2019-12-12: 'Chew three tablets as needed', or 1-3 before each meal) to keep the plan's zinc near 38 mg. Asher linked https://nutridyn.com/licorice-dgl-pro in that 2019 email; nutridyn.com is blocked from this session and NutriDyn's slugs changed after 2020, so the sheet keeps the catalog-search link. Photo: only the 89x160 chart thumbnail exists (products/img/R2193.png): LOW-RES, needs Asher's print master.

gerd_gi_integrity.name: GI Integrity
gerd_gi_integrity.key: 3 g L‑glutamine, 400 mg DGL, 300 mg aloe, 200 mg slippery elm, 16 mg zinc (as zinc carnosine)
gerd_gi_integrity.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'GI Integrity SS ND431' Rev. 12/24, Berry Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): about 1 scoop (8.5 g), about 28 servings; zinc (as zinc-carnosine) 16.1 mg, L-glutamine 3 g, glucosamine HCl 1 g, apple pectin 1 g, DGL powder 400 mg, aloe vera leaf gel extract 300 mg, slippery elm 200 mg, marshmallow, chamomile, okra, cat's claw, MSM, quercetin and prune 100 mg each, L-carnosine 62 mg ('Features 78 mg of zinc-carnosine'); flavors peach tea, chocolate, berry; 'Warning: Do not use if pregnant or nursing'. Okra is on the label (the line leaves it out only for space). Amounts match the products DB R327 chart reads (Pure, DFH, Ortho, Apex). Size line names the three flavors only: 'about 28 servings' holds for the 238 g Peach Tea (R325) and Berry (R327) tubs, not the 362.9 g Chocolate tub (R328), whose panel is not printed. URL: Asher's emails, 2024-01-18 and 2025-11-18. Photo: img-src/R325.png, the Peach Tea label (AI upscale of NutriDyn's 420 px web render).

gerd_spore_probio.name: UltraBiotic Spore Probio
gerd_spore_probio.key: Per 2 capsules: a 4‑strain spore probiotic blend (5 billion CFU), 300 mg XOS, 100 mg enzymes
gerd_spore_probio.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Spore Probio SS ND1135' Rev. 1/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 2 capsules, 30 servings; Spore Probiotic Complex 5 billion CFU (Weizmannia coagulans MTCC 5856, Pediococcus acidilactici NRRL B50517, Bacillus clausii MTCC 5980, Bacillus subtilis ATCC122264), xylooligosaccharides 300 mg, digestive enzyme blend 100 mg, PreforPro phage complex 15 mg; directions 'Take two capsules daily'. The key line follows the label's own name for the blend: Pediococcus acidilactici is a lactic-acid coccus that does not form spores, so 'spore-forming strains' would be wrong for one of the four. Same amounts as products DB R2196 (DFH, Ortho, Thorne, Microbiome Labs charts). URL from NutriDyn's launch email, 2024-04-04. Photo: only the 86x160 chart thumbnail is staged (LOW-RES). A crisp 248x420 NutriDyn web render of this bottle (60 capsules, current label, checked 2026-11-03) waits for central staging as img-src/R2196.png via stage_hires.py.

gerd_mag_glycinate.name: Magnesium Glycinate
gerd_mag_glycinate.key: 260 mg magnesium per 2 capsules, as Albion di‑magnesium malate and lysinate glycinate chelate
gerd_mag_glycinate.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Magnesium Glycinate SS ND413' Rev. 7/25, Supplement Facts (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 2 capsules, 30/60/80/160 servings; magnesium (as di-magnesium malate and magnesium lysinate glycinate chelate, Albion) 260 mg, malic acid 660 mg; directions 'Take two capsules twice daily'. Same as products DB R871/R872 (Pure, DFH, Ortho charts); sizes R871 60C, R871L 120C, R872 160C, R872L 320C. Sheet dose 2 a day (260 mg) stays under the 350 mg upper limit for supplemental magnesium (NIH ODS). URL: Asher's email, 2024-01-18, same slug as products.py. Photo pools with the shared magnesium-glycinate file (AI upscale).

gerd_essential_multi_iron.name: Essential Multi with Iron
gerd_essential_multi_iron.key: Per 3 capsules: 18 mg iron, 15 mg zinc, 200 mcg B12, 1,360 mcg DFE folate, 1,000 IU D3, 120 mcg vitamin K
gerd_essential_multi_iron.src: Used only when gerd.py PPI_PICK = 'multi' (Asher's pending call). Label facts: products DB R717, the NutriDyn Catalog ND143 (10/1/26) panel as read by the Pure, Ortho, Metagenics, NuMedica, Nutri-West and Biotics charts: per 3 capsules iron 18 mg (ferrous bisglycinate chelate), zinc 15 mg, vitamin B12 (methylcobalamin) 200 mcg, folate (L-5-MTHF) 1,360 mcg DFE, vitamin D3 25 mcg (1,000 IU), vitamin K 120 mcg, vitamin C 120 mg, magnesium 40 mg; directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food'; sizes R717 90C and R717L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). The sell sheet 'Essential Multi with Iron SS ND475' exists in the same Dropbox folder but was not opened in this pass. Asher's PPI-support email (2019-09-05) says 'Essential Multi'; the no-iron R716 is a second reading of it. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: only the 87x160 chart thumbnail: LOW-RES, needs a print master.
